# Introduction

EU-LOB is a catalogue of organizations recorded in European
lobbying registers. The eulob package provides access to a
bundled snapshot that can be queried without internet access.

This vignette describes the structure, identifiers, coverage
and methodological limitations of the catalogue.

# Register coverage

The catalogue includes 19 territorial scopes and 21 registers.

| Code | Register |
|------|----------|
| AT | Austrian Lobbying Register |
| CY | Cyprus Lobbying Register |
| DE | German Lobby Register |
| ES | Spanish CNMC Interest Groups Register |
| FI | Finnish Transparency Register |
| IE | Irish Register of Lobbying |
| LT | Lithuanian Lobbyists Register |
| RO | Romanian Lobbying Register |
| UE | EU Transparency Register |

UE represents the supranational EU register and is not an
ISO country code.

# Examine catalogue coverage

```{r}
library(eulob)
eulob_countries()
eulob_registers()
```

# Catalogue structure

Two RDS tables are bundled with the package.

## Names catalogue

The names.rds table contains:

- name_id: identifier associated with a normalized name.
- name_normalized: normalized representation.
- name: recorded name.
- n_entities: count of associated register entries.
- n_countries: count of associated territorial codes.

## Name-to-register relationships

The name_ids.rds table contains:

- name_id: normalized-name identifier.
- name_normalized: normalized name.
- name: recorded name.
- country: territorial or register code.
- register: source register.
- lobby_id: register-specific identifier.

The current snapshot contains 40,476 name records and
42,599 name-to-register relationships.

# Names and registered entities

A normalized name is not necessarily a unique legal entity.

Different registered entities may share the same name.
The same organization may also appear under different names.

The lobby_id field contains a register-specific identifier.
Its format varies across sources and may include official URLs.

Identifiers from different registers should not be assumed
to belong to a common identification system.

# Explore Spanish and German records

```{r}
head(eulob_lobbies(country = "ES"), 5)
head(eulob_lobbies(country = "DE"), 5)
```

# Interpreting counts

The n_names field counts distinct name identifiers.

The n_entities field counts distinct register identifiers
within each register. At territorial level, combinations
of register and identifier are used.

These counts do not represent globally deduplicated entities.

# Searching organizations

```{r}
eulob_search("universidad", limit = 5)
eulob_search("association", country = "UE", limit = 5)
```

The default search uses cosine similarity over character bigrams; literal substring matching is available with `method = "fixed"`.
against normalized names.

Fuzzy matching, semantic search and automatic cross-register
entity resolution are not currently implemented.

# Methodological limitations

Important considerations include:

- National registers may have different inclusion criteria.
- Register coverage and reporting obligations may vary.
- Names may contain spelling and legal-form variations.
- Identical normalized names do not prove common identity.
- Different identifiers may represent related organizations.
- Absence from a register does not establish absence of lobbying.
- Record counts are not directly comparable measures of activity.

# Data provenance and reproducibility

The catalogue is distributed as local RDS data.

Collection dates, source-specific licensing conditions,
normalization procedures and catalogue version identifiers
require further verification and documentation.

Researchers should record the package version and identify
the catalogue snapshot used in their analyses.

```{r}
eulob_version()
eulob_info()
```
